origins.section: 20.1. A SAF Holds Reports of Decisions Already Taken, Never a Request
20.2. An Entry Is Stored Before Anyone Is Told, and Leaves Only When It Is Acknowledged
20.3. Every Later Attempt Is a Repeat, and the Wait Grows Until a Reconnect Cuts It Short
20.6. The Receiver Applies Each Advice Once, by an Identity Its Repeats Share

gates.says: all 4 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-link-down-purchase: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-link-down-purchase: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-link-down-purchase: 20.1 says a request that can't be sent fails at once and only a sent, unanswered request is reversed into the SAF.
recorded.prompt:q-tell-order: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-tell-order: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-tell-order: 20.2's crash table (crash after tell: queue empty, cardholder pays 42.00) and 'Store first, then tell' make the reviewer right.
recorded.prompt:q-flapping-link: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-flapping-link: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-flapping-link: 20.3: a reconnect that resets the count never lets the head reach the limit of 20.4, and every entry behind it waits.
recorded.prompt:q-reversal-first: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-reversal-first: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-reversal-first: 20.6: a reversal that found nothing is remembered and its original is never posted; an advice is acknowledged without effect, a request is declined.

recorded.prompt:q-link-down-purchase:a: the page and the question, and nothing else

recorded.outcome:q-link-down-purchase:a: 20.1's admission check refuses 0200, and the 19:20 example shows a queued 0200 approved after the terminal showed failure and the customer paid cash.
recorded.prompt:q-link-down-purchase:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-link-down-purchase:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-link-down-purchase:c: 20.1 says requests are never stored, and 'fails at once' rules out pending.
recorded.prompt:q-link-down-purchase:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-link-down-purchase:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-link-down-purchase:d: 20.1's 'a request that can't be sent fails at once' rules out reporting it as pending.
recorded.prompt:q-tell-order:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-tell-order:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-tell-order:b: 20.2 names the harm of a crash after telling as no reversal stored, not a terminal left waiting.
recorded.prompt:q-tell-order:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-tell-order:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-tell-order:c: 20.2 asks whether order matters when the steps take milliseconds and answers with the crash table.
recorded.prompt:q-tell-order:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-tell-order:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-tell-order:d: 20.2: the terminal shows failure either way, yet the cardholder pays 42.00 with nothing queued.
recorded.prompt:q-flapping-link:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-flapping-link:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-flapping-link:b: 20.5: one sender takes the head and nothing else; while it waits, the entries behind it wait too.
recorded.prompt:q-flapping-link:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-flapping-link:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-flapping-link:c: 20.3: with the count reset at each reconnect the head never reaches its limit.
recorded.prompt:q-flapping-link:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-flapping-link:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-flapping-link:d: 20.3: only an attempt that went out counts; nothing is sent while the link is down.
recorded.prompt:q-reversal-first:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-reversal-first:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-reversal-first:b: 20.6: the original is never posted once a reversal has named it.
recorded.prompt:q-reversal-first:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-reversal-first:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-reversal-first:c: 20.1: an advice can't be refused, only acknowledged; 20.6 shows posting the late original as the naive host's error.
recorded.prompt:q-reversal-first:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-reversal-first:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-reversal-first:d: 20.1: the receiver can't refuse an advice, only acknowledge it.
